subject: Preboarding proof, background attestations, and deprovision schedule for Brightline
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@brightline.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@brightline.com
Date: 2028-07-22T09:12:00Z
Subject: Evidence request - preboarding proof and deprovision schedule

Hi Avery and Laura,

Thanks for taking this on. Pegasus Audit will begin our SIG/CAIQ evidence intake next week and they asked us to collect a small sample of personnel controls artifacts for Brightline's vendor pop (Redwood). Specifically they want:  

- A redacted sample of background check results for 5 recently onboarded engineers (redact PII but keep hiring dates, verification scope, and vendor name).
- Training completion exports showing mandatory security training and code of conduct for the same 5 people.
- The current onboarding and deprovisioning runbook (step-by-step) and the timeline for access removal after exits.
- An attestation signed by an authorized Redwood leader confirming that the sample is representative and that redaction steps were applied.

Deadline for initial intake: 2028-07-29 EOD PT. Pegasus also asked for any documented exception handling for delayed deprovisioning and the last three-month incident where access revocation was delayed (if applicable).

Let me know if we should send a DocuSign for the attestation or if you prefer an emailed signed PDF. If you need a narrower sample (e.g., by team), flag that and we'll coordinate with the auditor.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — small ask but critical for our audit window.

Best,
Elena
Elena Soto
Vendor Risk, Brightline Health

Attachments: request_summary.pdf (1 page)
From: avery_johnson@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@brightline.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-22T12:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request - preboarding proof and deprovision schedule

Elena,

Thanks — we can provide that. Proposed plan:  

1) I will pull a redacted archive of 5 recent background check summaries and confirm redaction rules (name, SSN, DOB removed; retain verification vendor, check type, and hire date).
2) Laura will export the training completion CSV for Q2 2028 filtered to those five IDs and include completion timestamps and training versions.
3) Attaching our current onboarding/deprovisioning runbook and a short matrix that shows who owns each step.
4) For the attestation, happy to sign via DocuSign. If you send the envelope link we will route to Vivek for signature (as CISO) and return within 48 hours.

Question: Pegasus asked for the "last three-month incident where access revocation was delayed" — we have one ticket from April where a contractor's offboarding was delayed 36 hours due to an HR sync issue. Do you want a short incident summary with remediation notes?

I'll upload the redacted sample to the secure drive link and share the DocuSign once Vivek confirms his availability. Expect the first bundle by 2028-07-25.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Program Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboard-offboard-playbook.pdf (pdf)
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@brightline.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@brightline.com, auditor@pegasus-audit.com
Date: 2028-07-23T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request - preboarding proof and deprovision schedule

Avery —

Yes, please include a short incident summary for the April contractor case (one paragraph is fine) and the remediation steps you applied. That will close the loop for Pegasus.

For the attestation, we initiated a DocuSign envelope (link below) that lists the attestation statement and a field for a corporate email signature. Please route to Vivek as the signer. If you prefer to provide a signed PDF, attach it to the intake folder but DocuSign is faster for auditors.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?envelopeId=7a2b3c4d
Intake folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/brightline-preboarding-playbook

We appreciate the ETA of 7/25 for the initial bundle — if anything slips beyond 7/26 please let us know immediately so Pegasus can reschedule.

Best,
Elena

Attachments: intake_checklist.xlsx
From: avery_johnson@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-25T16:04:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request - preboarding proof and deprovision schedule

Vivek / Grace — forwarding Brightline's intake request and Pegasus' cc. Action items (short):

- Vivek: sign the DocuSign attestation (link below) once you approve the redaction approach. I uploaded the redacted samples and the incident summary to the shared folder.
- Grace: please review the training CSV for the five-seat sample and confirm that the completion records show module versions and timestamps. If any records are missing, flag and I'll escalate to HR.
- Laura: thanks for the runbook export — can you add one line to the runbook that documents the SLAs for access removal by role? Pegasus asked for documented exception handling.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?envelopeId=7a2b3c4d
Shared folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/brightline-preboarding-playbook
